caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a matching lid positioned slightly above the main body of the teapot, suggesting it has been lifted off or is in the process of being removed. The teapot has a bulbous, rounded body with a series of vertical, elongated oval shapes along the lower half, giving it a ribbed or fluted appearance. The handle is large, curving in a semi-circular fashion on the left side, while the spout is elongated and curved, extending to the right. The lid has a knob on top and is ornamented with a series of smaller, radiating oval shapes. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray and black, creating a metallic effect and suggesting highlights and shadows. The background is plain and off-white, and there are faint vertical and horizontal fold lines running through the center of the paper. The edges of the drawing have some small stains and discoloration.
title: Teapot
